limits: The original challenge intentionally fails exact memory recovery. A passing diagnostic is not all recoveries passing.
One external /proc/PID/mem byte write occurs after a real pre-dump and before matching real final dump; present and soft-dirty bits plus stable PID are witnessed.
The candidate only redirects next pre-dump ancestry to previous complete process image; original current final-to-current-pre-dump semantics remain.
Separate Crab ZFS/filesystem worker, actual application workload, arbitrary concurrent threads/processes, model, optimizer and GPU training are not tested.
